title: CSP, sanitised dynamic HTML, hardened cookies, secret-free bundle
asA: user trusting the application with my data
iWant: the standard browser security floors actually in place
soThat: using the product does not expose me to script injection or session theft

acceptanceCriteria.description: A Content-Security-Policy is served on the application document with directives explicitly declared for at least default-src, script-src, style-src, img-src, connect-src, and frame-ancestors; no wildcard script-src.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the CSP is present with the named directives and no wildcard script source

acceptanceCriteria.description: User-influenced data never renders through raw HTML injection without passing the declared sanitiser; sanitiser bypasses do not exist in the codebase.
acceptanceCriteria.given: every render path for user-influenced content
acceptanceCriteria.then: each either escapes by default or routes through the sanitiser

acceptanceCriteria.description: Session cookies carry Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite attributes.
Form values containing markup round-trip as inert text: entered script fragments display as text and never execute.
acceptanceCriteria.when: a script fragment is entered, submitted, and re-rendered
acceptanceCriteria.then: the fragment displays as text with no execution

acceptanceCriteria.description: The shipped bundle contains no secrets: API keys, private endpoints, and credentials are absent from every emitted asset.
acceptanceCriteria.when: assets are scanned for secret patterns and known project secrets

acceptanceCriteria.description: Authenticated-only data never embeds in surfaces served to unauthenticated users, including prefetched state in the document.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the unauthenticated document and its embedded state
